main.summary: Result of one publication recovery evaluation.

property.name: Succeeded
property.summary: Indicates whether the recovery evaluation completed successfully.

property.name: FailureReason
property.summary: Reason recovery could not complete and should be retried.

method.name: Success
method.summary: Creates a result indicating that publication recovery completed successfully.
method.returns: A successful recovery result with no failure reason.

method.name: Failure
method.summary: Creates a result indicating that publication recovery could not complete.
method.param: Description of the failure that should be recorded and retried.
method.returns: A failed recovery result containing the supplied failure reason.
method.exception: Thrown when is null, empty, or consists only of white-space.
